name: Bouncy Buddies: Physics Puzzle 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Bouncy Buddies is a charming 2D physics-based puzzle adventure game that immerses you in a quirky, 80s-inspired world full of color and creativity. Use your clever thinking, quick reflexes, or sheer force to overcome a variety of puzzles as you journey to Evil Cyclox's castle to rescue Bouncy Jr.
